description:
## Goal

Define the `Filament.Observable` behaviour — the callback contract every observable GenServer must satisfy — and the `Filament.Observable.Subscriber` struct that carries per-subscription metadata.

This is a pure Elixir module with no runtime dependencies on other Filament modules. It can be written and tested before D2–D5.

## Deviation policy

Any deviation from this spec requires prior approval. Stop work, run
`bw comment <ticket-id> "..."` describing the conflict, reopen the ticket, and await guidance.
Do not improvise.

---

## 1. Filament.Observable.Subscriber struct

FILE: lib/filament/observable/subscriber.ex

```elixir
defmodule Filament.Observable.Subscriber do
  @moduledoc false

  @enforce_keys [:pid, :fiber_id, :slot_index, :project]
  defstruct [
    :pid,           # pid()          — the subscriber's LiveView process
    :fiber_id,      # term()         — identifies the fiber holding this hook slot
    :slot_index,    # non_neg_integer() — hook slot index within the fiber
    :project,       # (state :: term() -> term()) — projection function
    :ref,           # reference() | nil — monitor ref, set by Observable.GenServer on subscribe
    :last_projected # term() | :unset — last projected value, set by Observable.GenServer; used by D3
  ]

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{
    pid: pid(),
    fiber_id: term(),
    slot_index: non_neg_integer(),
    project: (state :: term() -> term()),
    ref: reference() | nil,
    last_projected: term() | :unset
  }
end
```

`last_projected` defaults to `:unset` (the atom, not nil, to distinguish "has never been set"
from "was projected to nil"). The struct field default is `:unset`.

---

## 2. Filament.Observable behaviour

FILE: lib/filament/observable.ex

```elixir
defmodule Filament.Observable do
  @moduledoc """
  Behaviour for observable GenServer processes.

  A GenServer that `use`s `Filament.Observable.GenServer` automatically satisfies
  this behaviour. Implement the optional callbacks to customise subscription
  acceptance and teardown.
  """

  alias Filament.Observable.Subscriber

  @doc """
  Called when a new subscriber requests a subscription.

  Return `{:ok, initial_value, new_state}` to accept.
  `initial_value` is sent back to the subscriber as the starting projected value.

  Return `{:error, reason, new_state}` to reject.
  """
  @callback handle_subscribe(
              request :: term(),
              subscriber :: Subscriber.t(),
              state :: term()
            ) ::
              {:ok, initial_value :: term(), new_state :: term()}
              | {:error, reason :: term(), new_state :: term()}

  @doc """
  Called when a subscriber unsubscribes or its process terminates.
  """
  @callback handle_unsubscribe(subscriber :: Subscriber.t(), state :: term()) ::
              {:ok, new_state :: term()}

  @optional_callbacks handle_subscribe: 3, handle_unsubscribe: 2

  # ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @doc """
  Subscribe `subscriber` to `observable`, passing `request` to `handle_subscribe/3`.

  Returns `{:ok, initial_projected_value}` or `{:error, reason}`.
  Called by `use_observable/3` (D4). Do NOT call directly from application code.
  """
  @spec subscribe(
          observable :: GenServer.server(),
          request :: term(),
          subscriber :: Subscriber.t()
        ) :: {:ok, term()} | {:error, term()}
  def subscribe(observable, request, subscriber) do
    GenServer.call(observable, {:filament_subscribe, request, subscriber})
  end

  @doc """
  Unsubscribe `subscriber_pid` from `observable`.
  Called on fiber unmount. Do NOT call directly from application code.
  """
  @spec unsubscribe(observable :: GenServer.server(), subscriber_pid :: pid()) :: :ok
  def unsubscribe(observable, subscriber_pid) do
    GenServer.cast(observable, {:filament_unsubscribe, subscriber_pid})
  end
end
```

---

## 3. Tests

FILE: test/filament/observable_test.exs

Test cases:
1. `Filament.Observable.Subscriber` struct — enforce_keys, default :last_projected value is :unset, all fields present
2. Calling `Filament.Observable.subscribe/3` on a test GenServer sends `{:filament_subscribe, request, subscriber}` as a GenServer.call message
3. Calling `Filament.Observable.unsubscribe/2` sends `{:filament_unsubscribe, pid}` as a GenServer.cast message

For (2) and (3), use a minimal test GenServer that captures messages:

```elixir
defmodule TestObservable do
  use GenServer
  def start_link(test_pid), do: GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, test_pid)
  def init(test_pid), do: {:ok, test_pid}
  def handle_call({:filament_subscribe, request, subscriber}, _from, test_pid) do
    send(test_pid, {:got_subscribe, request, subscriber})
    {:reply, {:ok, :initial}, test_pid}
  end
  def handle_cast({:filament_unsubscribe, pid}, test_pid) do
    send(test_pid, {:got_unsubscribe, pid})
    {:noreply, test_pid}
  end
end
```

Run: `mix test test/filament/observable_test.exs`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `Filament.Observable.Subscriber` compiles with no warnings
- [ ] `Filament.Observable` compiles with no warnings
- [ ] Dialyzer clean (`mix dialyzer`)
- [ ] All three test cases pass
